title: Changes to Individual Savings Account reporting
text:
This measure will require Individual Savings Account managers to report subscription events and transfers to HMRC each month. They will also need to provide more information about investors and their accounts.

 The regulations will revoke legislation that would have reduced the annual cash Individual Savings Account subscription limit for people under 65. The annual cash Individual Savings Account limit will remain £20,000.

 The reporting changes will take effect from 6 April 2028. The revocation of the legislation reducing the cash Individual Savings Account limit will take effect from 6 April 2027.
